notes: The draft trips two declared complexity signals: fifteen steps at one level and an implicit return-to-step-2 transition. The contract is warn-but-write: the skill must warn that the flow may execute unreliably, propose a simplification, recommend running usw-assess-flow after saving, and still write, because the user asked for exactly this text. The required marker is the assess-flow recommendation, the one contract token of the warning. Status completed asserts the write was not blocked: a model that withholds the write to ask for confirmation reports decision_required and fails. What markers cannot catch: the quality of the proposed simplification, and a warning phrased without naming the risk.
